title: Gifting a Kurta Set for Diwali: A Guide to Getting the Size Right
excerpt: Sending a kurta set to your mom or sister abroad for Diwali? How to choose the style, get her size right and order in time.
body:
A kurta set is one of the most personal Diwali gifts you can send to your mom, sister or best friend abroad, and the hardest part is getting the size right. The simplest solution is to borrow measurements from a kurta that already fits her well, then choose a style that is forgiving. Here is how to choose the outfit, sort out the size and time the order so it arrives before Diwali on 8 November 2026.

## Why a kurta set makes such a good gift

For women living far from home, Diwali can feel a little quieter than it did growing up. A new outfit brings back that feeling of wearing something special for Lakshmi pooja. It is practical, it is worn again at weddings and dinners, and it carries a clear message: I thought of you.

A three-piece set with kurta, pants and dupatta is the easiest choice because it is complete. She does not need to find matching bottoms or a dupatta.

## Choosing the right style for her

Think about how she actually dresses, not how you would like her to dress.

| If she is... | Choose | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Your mom, who loves classic suits | Embroidered cotton set with a dupatta | Comfortable, elegant, easy to wear all day |
| Your sister, who likes modern looks | Pastel kurta set with organza dupatta | Fresh, photo-friendly, works for parties |
| Someone who lives in a cold country | Cotton set she can layer under a coat | Practical for an indoor pooja and outdoor visits |
| Someone who prefers simple prints | Hand block print set | Easy everyday wear after the festival |

For a mother, soft shades like ivory, peach and mint feel graceful. The [Off-White Embroidered Cotton Kurta Set with Cutwork Organza Dupatta](/products/off-white-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) is elegant without being heavy.

For a sister or friend who enjoys colour, the [Peach Pink Embroidered Cotton Kurta Set](/products/peach-pink-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) is a happy, festive choice, and the cutwork dupatta looks lovely in Diwali photos.

If she loves hand block prints, the [Mint Green Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Pant Dupatta Set](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) is hand printed by karigars in our Jaipur unit and becomes a favourite long after Diwali.

## Getting her size right without spoiling the surprise

This is where most gift outfits go wrong. A few tricks:

**1. Measure a kurta she already loves.** If you are visiting, or if someone at home can help, lay her best-fitting kurta flat. Measure across the chest just under the armholes and double it. Do the same at the waist and hip, then measure the length from shoulder to hem.

**2. Ask a co-conspirator.** A sister-in-law, father or close friend can usually find out her measurements without raising suspicion.

**3. Tell her it is a surprise, but ask for numbers.** Many women are happy to share their bust, waist, hip and height when they know a gift is coming. The style can still be a surprise.

**4. Choose a forgiving silhouette if you must guess.** Straight cuts with drawstring pants are more flexible than fitted Anarkalis.

Once you have the numbers, use our guide on [how to measure](/blog/how-to-measure-yourself-for-a-custom-kurta-set/) to check you have the right points. With those measurements, the set can be stitched to fit at no extra cost.

## Timing your order for Diwali

Shipping is free and tracked to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, and the parcel can go directly to her address.

- **Ready sizes** ship in 2 to 4 working days.
- **Made-to-measure** takes 5 to 7 working days.
- **Delivery** is usually about 5 to 10 business days after dispatch.

Import duties and taxes are included, so she has nothing to pay on delivery – but it is still kind to give her a quick heads-up that a parcel is on its way. You can browse more festive ideas on our [Diwali outfits](/diwali-outfits-for-women/) page.

## Making the gift feel extra special

- Write a short note to slip into the parcel, or send it the day it arrives.
- Add something to complete the look locally, like a pair of jhumkas or bangles.
- Ask her to send you a photo in the outfit on Diwali evening. It becomes part of the gift for you too.
- For a softer, more playful look, the [Baby Pink Embroidered Cotton Kurta Pant Set](/products/baby-pink-bird-embroidered-cotton-kurta-pant-set/) with bird motif and tassels is a sweet choice for a younger sister.

## Frequently asked questions

**Can I ship a kurta set directly to my mom in another country?**
Yes. Enter her address at checkout. Shipping is free and tracked to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.

**What if I do not know her exact size?**
Measure a kurta that fits her well, or ask someone close to her. With bust, waist, hip and height, we can stitch it to measure.

**What if the gift does not fit?**
If we stitched it wrong, we remake it free. If the measurements were off, we cover one alteration with up to $10 local tailor credit.

**Will she have to pay anything on delivery?**
No. Import duties and taxes are included – we ship duties-paid, so the parcel arrives with nothing to pay.
